name: 98045 · North Bend, WA
findings: ZIP 98045 (North Bend) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98045 (North Bend) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98045 (North Bend) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.
